name: o90831

zeppelin_java_opts.description: Sets ZEPPELIN_JAVA_OPTS.  You can use this to set arbitrary spark configuration properties (e.g. spark.mesos.uris)

executor_docker_image.description: The docker image to launch Spark executors with.  By default, this will use this value specified in this package's resource.json

uri.description: A URI serving the Spark distribution to use for the local Zeppelin Spark context.  By default, this will use the value specified in this package's resource.json

description:
The Zeppelin service will be identified by the name **zeppelin**. For its runtime we are configuring `ZEPPELIN_JAVA_OPTS` with the following flags: `-Dspark.mesos.coarse=true -Dspark.mesos.executor.home=/opt/spark/dist -Dspark.driver.memory=1g`.  

In the Spark configuration we are limiting the total number of cores to **8** (`spark.cores.max=8`). Each executor will be allocated **4g** of memory (`spark.executor.memory=4g`) and will run inside the Docker image `docker.io/library/spark-executor:3.4.0`. The Spark distribution will be fetched from the URI `https://downloads.apache.org/spark/spark-3.4.0/spark-3.4.0-bin-hadoop3.tgz`.
